capabilities: Preview headings and their text on hover
Jump to sections by click or by dragging along the rail
Bookmark headings from the heading preview
Customize rail shape, colours, labels, and placement with presets
extras: Developed with AI assistance; requires Obsidian 1.2.7 or later; deeper customization is documented in a separate customization reference; works locally with no network requests.
problem: Heading navigation normally requires opening the Outline sidebar, and long notes give no constant sense of where you are.
summary: Heading rail in the note margin that previews headings and jumps between sections of long notes, in reading and editing views.
